description: An oxygen tank is leaking. The air pressure is falling!
sourceDescription: Warning! Pressure is dropping because an oxygen storage tank is leaking!

left.label: Use a backup tank
left.description: Switch to a backup oxygen tank right away!
left.sourceResponse: Switch to a backup oxygen tank right away!

right.label: Wait and see
right.description: Just wait and hope it stops leaking.
right.sourceResponse: Just wait and hope it stops leaking.

description: The carbon dioxide filter broke. The crew has headaches.
sourceDescription: The Four Bed Molecular Sieve (CO2 removal) broke down. The crew has headaches from bad air!

left.label: Use LiOH canisters
left.description: Use lithium hydroxide (LiOH) canisters to absorb the gas.
left.sourceResponse: Use lithium hydroxide (LiOH) canisters to absorb the gas.

right.label: Keep working
right.description: Ignore it and keep working with no filters.
right.sourceResponse: Ignore it and keep working with no filters.

description: Water recycling has failed. We need clean drinking water.
sourceDescription: The multifiltration water processor failed. Total reliance on recycling is threatened!

left.label: Use reserve water
left.description: Draw emergency drinking water from the survival storage reserve.
left.sourceResponse: Draw emergency drinking water from the survival storage reserve.

right.label: Push the recycler
right.description: Force the Vapor Compression Distillation (VCD) unit to run past its limits.
right.sourceResponse: Force the Vapor Compression Distillation (VCD) unit to run past its limits.

description: The crew needs more oxygen. How much should we release?
sourceDescription: The crew needs more oxygen pumped into the cabin from the high-pressure storage tanks.

left.label: Open the valves
left.description: Open the main oxygen valves wider!
left.sourceResponse: Open the main oxygen valves wider!

right.label: Limit the flow
right.description: Keep the valves half-closed to save tank safety.
right.sourceResponse: Keep the valves half-closed to save tank safety.

description: The machine that uses water to make oxygen is overheating!
sourceDescription: The Solid Polymer Water Electrolysis machine that splits water to make fresh oxygen is overheating.
imageAlt: An astronaut holds a drink pouch.
imageCaption: An astronaut holds a drink pouch.

left.label: Cool the machine
left.description: Send extra electrical power to cool down the electrolysis unit!
left.sourceResponse: Send extra electrical power to cool down the electrolysis unit!

right.label: Make less oxygen
right.description: Slow down the oxygen production to save electricity.
right.sourceResponse: Slow down the oxygen production to save electricity.

description: The Sabatier reactor broke. Use stored oxygen or keep it on?
sourceDescription: The Sabatier carbon dioxide reduction reactor broke down! If we don't fix it, we will lose the oxygen tied up in exhaled gases.
imageAlt: An astronaut works on life-support equipment.
imageCaption: An astronaut works on life-support equipment.

left.label: Use stored oxygen
left.description: Vent the carbon dioxide into space and rely purely on our limited stored oxygen tanks.
left.sourceResponse: Vent the carbon dioxide into space and rely purely on our limited stored oxygen tanks.

right.label: Keep reactor on
right.description: Force the broken reactor to keep running to recycle every drop of oxygen.
right.sourceResponse: Force the broken reactor to keep running to recycle every drop of oxygen.

description: An empty growing tray is ready. Lettuce or soybeans?
sourceDescription: We have an empty growing tray. Should we plant lettuce for an earlier harvest or soybeans for a larger harvest later?
imageAlt: Plants grow inside a space experiment.
imageCaption: Plants grow inside a space experiment.

left.label: Plant lettuce
left.sourceResponse: Plant lettuce / consequence: A lettuce crop begins growing.

right.label: Plant soybeans
right.description: Choose soybeans for a larger harvest later.

description: The battery is almost full. Its power lines are hot!
sourceDescription: The space station battery is charging up toward its 15 kWh limit, but the power lines are getting hot!
imageAlt: Solar collectors at a power facility on Earth.
imageCaption: Solar collectors at a power facility on Earth.

left.label: Pause charging
left.description: Pause battery charging and let the power lines cool.

right.label: Keep charging
right.description: Keep charging the battery while watching the hot power lines.

description: A Martian dust storm is covering our solar panels.
sourceDescription: A massive Martian dust storm is heading straight for us! Dust is starting to coat our solar panels.
imageAlt: Dust over the surface of Mars.
imageCaption: Dust over the surface of Mars.

left.label: Clean the panels
left.description: Send crew outside immediately to clean the solar panels!
left.sourceResponse: Send crew outside immediately to clean the solar panels!

right.label: Stay inside
right.description: Ignore the dust and stay safe inside the habitat.
right.sourceResponse: Ignore the dust and stay safe inside the habitat.

description: Dust blocks sunlight. The base is making less power.
sourceDescription: Because we didn't clean the dust off, the solar panels are choking!
imageAlt: A dusty solar panel on Mars.
imageCaption: A dusty solar panel on Mars.

left.label: Turn off extras
left.description: Shut down non-vital habitat systems to save the remaining battery power.
left.sourceResponse: Shut down non-vital habitat systems to save what is left of our 15 kWh power pool.

right.label: Keep systems on
right.description: Keep all systems running and burn through our emergency battery reserves.
right.sourceResponse: Keep all systems running and burn through our emergency battery reserves.

description: A solar flare is coming. Should we use the storm shelter?
sourceDescription: Mission control warns of an incoming solar flare! Radiation levels are spiking outside our standard radiation shielding.
imageAlt: An illustration of a spacecraft near the Sun.
imageCaption: An illustration of a spacecraft near the Sun.

left.label: Use the shelter
left.description: Order the crew into the heavily shielded central storm shelter immediately!
left.sourceResponse: Order the crew into the heavily shielded central storm shelter immediately!

right.label: Work outside
right.description: Ignore the warning and keep working outside to maintain food crop modules.
right.sourceResponse: Ignore the warning and keep working outside to maintain food crop modules.

description: The water recycler is clogged. Flush it or keep it running?
sourceDescription: The Vapor Compression Distillation (VCD) machine that recycles urine and wastewater is clogged with heavy deposits!
imageAlt: An illustration of a space base.
imageCaption: An illustration of a space base.

left.label: Flush the recycler
left.description: Flush the system immediately using extra water and high electrical power to clean it.
left.sourceResponse: Flush the system immediately using extra water and high electrical power to clean it.

right.label: Keep it running
right.description: Ignore the clogging and keep running the dirty machine.
right.sourceResponse: Ignore the clogging and keep running the dirty machine.

description: The water recycler stopped. Wastewater is piling up!
sourceDescription: Because we didn't clean the VCD processor, the recycling system completely broke down! Wastewater is piling up

left.label: Use stored water
left.description: Open emergency stored water reserves to keep the base hydrated.
left.sourceResponse: Open emergency stored water reserves to keep the base hydrated.

right.label: Run it anyway
right.description: Force the broken machine to run without repairs, risking total water loss.
right.sourceResponse: Force the broken machine to run without repairs, risking total water loss.
